liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Maggie's Farm** (2 reviews): Thirteen-minute jam into Cumberland Blues described as non-stop and delightful; Jam after father verse features disjointed yet unified playing with Phil bombs [10][11]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-11-14.122199.sbd.miller.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 17 songs; 135 min; rated 4.6/5 by 5 [1]
- **gd87-11-14.aud.willy.15823.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 17 songs; 131 min; rated 4.56/5 by 9 [3]. Said about its sound: Shakedown Street is loud and funky; Althea is thin but bouncy [12]
- **gd1987-11-14.143686.aud.senn441.Flair-Krobar.flac1644**: audience recording; 17 songs; 135 min [6]. Said about its sound: Recording captures the boominess of the room; tape flips after tracks 5 and 11 [6]
- **gd1987-11-14.sbd-nak.miller.norman.stephens.14675.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 16 songs; 133 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [7]. Said about its sound: Both sets pack a late 80s punch with wind in the sails [16]

## Around the show

- Jerry used ketamine backstage, altering Pocky Way lyrics to Milky [14]
- Brent and Phil levitated the crowd during a super low E in Terrapin [19]
- Named one of the best shows of 1987, with a monster second set [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-11-14.122199.sbd.miller.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette [1]. Also: Tape flip occurred at start of Deal; pitch correction by Joe B. Jones [1]
- **gd87-11-14.aud.willy.15823.sbeok.shnf**: source: AUD>MC>DAT>CD [3]. Also: Reviewer taped the show personally but found the sound quality poor [13]
- **gd1987-11-14.143686.aud.senn441.Flair-Krobar.flac1644**: taped by Jason Flair; transferred by Krobar and Jason Flair; source: Sennheiser 441>tcd5m>cas(1st Gen Copy Made On Matching Calibrated Dragons mx-90 master,mx-90 copy) [6]
- **gd1987-11-14.sbd-nak.miller.norman.stephens.14675.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Charlie Miller and Todd Norman; source: SBD -> Cm -> Cass -> Sony SBM1(Modified) -> VX Pocket -> Samplitude -> Cool Edit Pro -> SHN; FOB Nak?s>cassette master>DAT>CDR>EAC>SHN; SBD>Cm>?>SHN [7]
